descricao_original: Osteoblasts are large, plump cells that lie on bony surfaces and secrete the organic components of the extracellular matrix, ground substance and collagen fibers. They occur in the endosteum and are also located on the external surfaces of bone associated with the innermost layer of the periosteum. 600x, 600x

marcadores.explicacao_original: Osteoid is composed of ground substance (mostly proteoglycans) and collagen fibers. It appears as a pale band lying on the bone surface beneath the osteoblasts. Osteoid rapidly becomes mineralized with calcium phosphate (hydroxyapatite).
